description: Partial OLS slopes (d index / d fraction) of NDVI, spring NDVI, NDBI, MNDWI and albedo on the five land-cover fractions (with intercept; other vegetation is the omitted reference class), fitted on all cells and frames. A fraction change exchanges land with the other fractions and the implicit other-vegetation share in proportion to their current values; each index shifts by the sum of slope x actual fraction change (clamped to its range); ndvi_drop = ndvi_spring - ndvi is recomputed; the 3- and 15-cell focal means are recomputed on the grid and distances are held fixed.

derived.ndvi_spring: follows a direct NDVI shift by the same amount; coupled explicitly for fraction changes
